$description: Jeremiah's colour inputs, verbatim (never edited by the pipeline; first collected for Pop P1b2, 2026-10-02). Since Pop P1c they are the source of the shipped callout / negative / success / gold / brown ramps (studio/scripts/generate-oklch-palettes.mjs → design/tokens/core/color.ramps.json) and are still layered under the archived round-2 proposals. Never sent to Swift.

callout.$description: Jeremiah's Callout ramp (blue), verbatim from his Figma swatches (2026-10-02).

negative.$description: Jeremiah's Negative ramp (red), verbatim from his Figma swatches (2026-10-02).

success.$description: Jeremiah's Success ramp (green), verbatim from his Figma swatches (2026-10-02).

gold.$description: Jeremiah's gold → brown spectrum: 8 swatches sampled from his image, so values are approximate. Steps 1–5 are light golds, 6–8 dark browns; there are no mid browns (OKLCH L jumps 0.80 → 0.23 between 5 and 6). Kept verbatim; the lightness-matched rebuild is gold-oklch.

filament.$description: Filaments Jeremiah prints with most. Sampled from photos, so approximate. His mixes: (a) 65 % light gray, 25 % orange, 10 % black or space gray; (b) 60 % light gray, 30 % space gray or black, 10 % orange.
